updates.content:
Title: Admins may be unable to access Best Practices content in the Microsoft Teams admin center

User impact: Admins may be unable to access Best Practices content in the Microsoft Teams admin center.

More info: In addition, admins are unable to conduct Call Quality Dashboard (CQD) queries in the Microsoft Teams admin center.

Current status: We've identified a recent service update that introduced a code regression and is affecting a subset of service infrastructure that helps facilitate access to Best Practices content in the Microsoft Teams admin center. We've conducted our change reversion process to remove the change and remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue is preventing some admins in North America and Japan from accessing Best Practices content or from conducting CQD report queries in the Microsoft Teams admin center.

Start time: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent update has introduced a code regression for the subset of infrastructure that supports access to the Best Practices content in the Microsoft Teams admin center.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:00 PM UTC
